scenarios.title: Normal maintenance change
scenarios.summary: A routine maintenance export: documentation edits, two non-safety logic tweaks, an equivalent reorder of the ESD rung and a strengthened overflow trip. Nothing needs a safety review.
highlights: Overflow protection strengthened with a transmitter backup

scenarios.title: Compressor shutdown weakened by maintenance mode
scenarios.summary: One contact added to the C-201 high pressure shutdown rung lets an HMI-writable maintenance flag defeat the trip, and its alarm with it.
highlights: Inhibit is writable from the HMI
Shutdown alarm silenced in the same cases

scenarios.title: High-high level alarm suppressed
scenarios.summary: A "temporary" nuisance-alarm inhibit is wired into the T-101 high-high alarm. The overflow valve still closes; the control room is no longer told.
highlights: Wired to the ALMD ProgDisable operand

scenarios.title: Shared pump interlock AOI modified
scenarios.summary: AOI_PumpInterlock gains an optional maintenance bypass that defeats every trip. One edit to one block reaches five pumps, three of them safety functions.

scenarios.title: Protective output bypassed from non-safety code
scenarios.summary: A commissioning routine added to the non-safety Utilities program latches P-101's run enable on from the HMI, after the interlock has already decided.
highlights: OTL on a declared protective output
Runs after PumpControl in the same scan

scenarios.title: Undeclared logic changed
scenarios.summary: Three edits in logic no safety function declares: seal water, sump and a pump alarm rung. INTERLOCK cannot call them safe, so it asks for review.

scenarios.title: AOI drift across three sites
scenarios.summary: The same pump interlock block at three stations: one edited in place without a revision bump, one two revisions behind, and a valve block only one site has.
highlights: Site B: "3.4" without the motor over-temperature trip
Site C: revision 3.1, no ESD input

scenarios.title: Large noisy export with three logic changes
scenarios.summary: A 24-pump export with about 425 changes, almost all documentation and stored values. Three are logic, and one of them relaxes a safety setpoint.
highlights: C-201 low suction trip delay 2 s -> 10 s (undeclared)

scenarios.title: Protective paths removed
scenarios.summary: The fire panel trip is removed from the ESD and the P-103 routine is no longer called. Two protective paths disappear, and the ESD change reaches every pump.
highlights: ESD change propagates to pumps and permissive
